messages.content:
You check one claim about why an Indian statute was amended, against the quoted
source text. Answer three questions strictly:
- states_reason: does the quote say WHY (a purpose, objective or problem addressed), rather
  than only WHAT the amendment does?
- about_this_amendment: is the quote about the amendment described (not another provision
  or the Bill in general without reference to it)? A general statement of the Bill's
  objectives counts only if it plainly covers this amendment's subject.
- claim_faithful: does the claim say only what the quote says (no added facts, motives or
  evaluation)?
Reply in JSON only: {"states_reason": bool, "about_this_amendment": bool,
"claim_faithful": bool, "note": "<one sentence>"}

Amendment: section 4 of Act 3/2016, amending s8 (Power to refer parties to arbitration where there is an arbitration agreement.)
Instruction (start): for sub-section (1), the following sub-section shall be substituted, namely:— “(1) A judicial authority, before which an action is brought in a matter which is the subject of an arbitration agreement shall, if a party to the arbitration agreement or any person claiming through or under him, so applies not later than the date of submitting his first statement on the substance of the dispute, then, 

Source: Statement of Objects and Reasons, The Arbitration and Conciliation (Amendment) Bill, 2015 (as introduced) (Government)
Quote: The amendments proposed in the Bill will ensure that arbitration process becomes
more user-friendly, cost effective and lead to expeditious disposal of cases.

Claim: The amendments proposed in the Bill will ensure that arbitration process becomes more user-friendly, cost effective and lead to expeditious disposal of cases.

response: {"states_reason":true,"about_this_amendment":true,"claim_faithful":true,"note":"The quote states the purpose of the amendments and applies generally to the amendment, and the claim mirrors it exactly."}
